in_latin.name: Siana
in_latin.long_meaning: Siana – derived from the Latin word gratia, meaning 'grace.' This name may also be derived from the Latin word sanus, meaning 'healthy' or 'whole,' as the name Siana was borne by a woman who was healed of leprosy in the New Testament (Luke 17:11).

in_english.name: Siana
in_english.long_meaning: Siana – derived from the English word grace, meaning 'the free and unmerited favor of God; the virtue coming from God; the state of God's favor.' This name may also be derived from the English word sian, meaning 'welcoming,' 'hospitable,' or 'generous,' as the name Siana is also used as a Welsh name meaning 'hospitable.' (Note: The Welsh name Sian is unrelated to the name Siana found in the New Testament.)
